shortDescription: FLock (FLOCK) is scheduled to unlock about 168.04 million tokens at 12:00 AM Beijing time on September 30, according to Web3 asset data platform RootData's token unlock data. According to ChainCatcher, the tokens are valued at about $5.65 million.
